event_data.context: PR #31 signed 7c8aeed ports release legacy candidate counting, codec skips and checkpoint progress as an explicit filter. All 105 tests passed in the signed gate, including a real SQLite journal reopened with an incompatible event decoder. Main CI 45535963851 is green after the PostgreSQL UUIDv7 merge. The legacy SQL cursor and native SQL filter audit remains open.
